items.detail: AC1: scripts/board_shrink_check.py:175 computes lost = sorted(old[1]-new[1]) from baseline vs candidate id sets; line 186 'if new[0] < old[0] or lost:' refuses on missing identity regardless of count; lines 187-200 print 'REFUSED' naming the lost ids. The commit message of 4de11c4 confirms the pre-fix code was count-only ('if new[0] < old[0]' alone) with a test asserting the hole. SHRINK ACCEPTED' exit=0.
